name: AYM Syntex Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1985, AYM Syntex 
Ltd is a manufacturer and exporter 
of Polyester Filament Yarn, Nylon
Filament Yarn and Bulk, Continuous 
Filament Yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ASL is a leading manufacturer of multi-polymer technical yarn catering to various applications, including fashion textiles, automotive interiors, and industrial sectors. It is led by experienced leadership with a strong textiles and manufacturing engineering background.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.69% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.97% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -8.10%
